envelope.description: The local provider raises ModelCallFailedError on every transport failure; the retry helper keeps the type

body.title: The local provider raises ModelCallFailedError on every transport failure; the retry helper keeps the type
body.summary: In src/agent/providers/ollama.ts, wrapOllamaError and every call site that rethrows a transport error (complete with its retry, stream creation, an error thrown while a stream is iterated) raise ModelCallFailedError. In src/agent/providers/structured-output.ts the retry helper re-throws a ModelCallFailedError (detail prefixed with its attempt count) when its last attempt threw one, instead of a plain Error. The provider wraps every transport failure the Ollama client raises (from the call and from inside each for-await stream loop) as ModelCallFailedError with the original as cause; it does not filter on a list of message texts. ModelCallFailedError (src/agent/providers/model-call-error.ts:12) takes only a detail today (constructor at :16); t1 adds an optional second argument { cause?: unknown } passed to super, so the original failure is kept.
acceptanceChecks: A stand-in Ollama client that throws Error('connect ECONNREFUSED'), Error('socket hang up'), TypeError('fetch failed'), TypeError('terminated') or rejects mid-iteration makes the provider raise ModelCallFailedError on complete, on stream creation and during stream iteration.
The retry helper re-throws a ModelCallFailedError when its last attempt threw one; its message carries the helper's attempt prefix.
A ModelCallFailedError raised by the provider carries the client's original error as its cause.

tests.name: OllamaProvider: a connection refused / socket hang up / stream ended early is raised as ModelCallFailedError
OllamaProvider: a socket failure during stream iteration is raised as ModelCallFailedError
retry helper: a ModelCallFailedError on the last attempt is re-thrown as a ModelCallFailedError with the attempt prefix
